'''Nova Orion Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. It was built by and served as the headquarters for [[Nova Orion Industries]].

==Behind the scenes==
Nova Orion Station and the surrounding Bright Jewel system were added to ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' with Chapter 8 in January 2008. It was a copy of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] which was used in the game's introductory player tutorial, but with different inhabitants and quests. It was only accessible to players that owned a ship. Star Wars Galaxies was shut down on [[December 15]], 2011.
